The Studio Ethos

Saint Peter Studio operates on a singular principle: like a ghostwriter, but for the canvas. The creator remains entirely in the shadows, leaving the ego out of the equation so the work can speak for itself.

Based in Taranaki, New Zealand, the practice bypasses conventional decorative tropes to investigate the darker, heavier corners of the psyche. Every piece serves as a vital mechanism for processing internal friction—transforming psychological shadow into hard-won mental and spiritual balance.

The Material History

Every piece is built exclusively on recycled canvases. By utilizing salvaged surfaces that already carry their own hidden histories, scars, and prior lives, the work begins with pre-existing depth. The physical layering of acrylic and mixed-media across these weathered surfaces creates a tactile, uncompromising dialogue between what was left behind and what is brought to light.

Selected Works

01

Portal of Sight

Acrylic and mixed-media on recycled canvas · 2026 · 35 × 28 in (89 × 71 cm)

For sale

Signed, with certificate of authenticity

Inquire
Centering on a stark, luminous aperture ringed in deep crimson, Portal of Sight examines the moment of sudden, uncompromised awareness. Light cuts through the dark canvas in sharp, geometric vectors, illuminating a solitary figure grounded in the lower register. The piece explores the psychological weight of sudden clarity—the uncomfortable, brilliant process of facing what lies beyond the surface of everyday perception.
02

Illumination

Acrylic and mixed-media on recycled canvas · 2026 · 35 × 28 in (89 × 71 cm)

For sale

Signed, with certificate of authenticity

Inquire
In Illumination, a solitary figure sits facing an intense, burning core of crimson and gold. Eschewing soft mysticism, the composition frames enlightenment not as a tranquil escape, but as a severe, transformative trial. The heavy contrast and stark shadows demand absolute presence, capturing the deliberate act of holding one’s ground while being stripped down to essential truth.
03

Aperture of the Void

Acrylic and mixed-media on recycled canvas · 2025 · 31 × 31 in (79 × 79 cm)

For sale

Signed, with certificate of authenticity

Inquire
Aperture of the Void confronts the heavy, unvarnished reality of psychological dissolution—the alchemical descent into the dark, raw sludge where old certainties break down. Out of this heavily textured, shadowed void cuts a violent, unyielding flash of divine illumination. At its epicenter sits an unblinking, piercing focal point: the absolute aperture of inner gnosis. The piece strips away superficial illusions, capturing the stark moment when awareness cuts straight through the noise and stares the abyss dead in the face without flinching.
04

The Blood-Rimmed Orbit

Acrylic · 2025 · 30 × 30 in (76 × 76 cm)

For sale

Signed, with certificate of authenticity

Inquire
The Blood-Rimmed Orbit rejects polite detachment, confronting the viewer with an unblinking gaze into the heavy, unsettling undercurrents of the universe. A pale, cratered moon hangs suspended over black, indifferent water like an ancient bruise, crowned by a rust-colored halo that bleeds across the horizon. The composition evokes the tactile density of copper, wet slate, and a profound, suffocating silence—capturing the chilling realization that the dark is not merely an absence of light, but an active, watching presence waiting at the edge of the tide.
